==Summary==

{{pov|[[Rand al'Thor]]}}

Rand wanders the streets in Ebou Dar and becomes impressed with the order the [[Seanchan]] have brought to the city. He talked with one of the many bands of [[Tuatha'an|Tinkers]] the night before and found they were considering settling, having found some place where they aren't persecuted. He begins to wonder if he has chosen the right path for holding in his emotions, since he almost killed his father. He again begins planning to destroy the Seanchan. His plan is to destroy the [[Tarasin Palace]], where the [[Daughter of the Nine Moons]] lives, then destroy the fleet in the harbor. He would then begin [[traveling]] around destroying garrisons and supply depots. He could then do the same in other countries held by the Seanchan.

He seizes ''[[saidin]]'' and is gripped by the worst nausea ever, and falls to the ground holding the [[Access key|access key]]. A crowd gathers near him, looking concerned for his well-being. Instead of beginning his attack, he makes a [[Gateways|Gateway]] and [[Skimming|skims]] rather than travels and curls up on the platform. He arrives at a field where he fought the Seanchan. He makes another Gateway and travels to the top of Dragonmount, created by the death of [[Lews Therin Telamon]]. He makes a fire with ''saidin'', sets the Access Key down on the ground and begins to think.
